top_signals.title: Corn Drops Most in Three Weeks as Profit-Taking Hits Grain Rally
top_signals.summary: Corn futures fell the most in around three weeks as traders took profits after an extended rally driven by geopolitical and weather risks.

top_signals.title: Hackers expose donor data from Russian fundraisers for Ukrainians, political prisoners
top_signals.summary: Hackers reportedly gained access to payment accounts used by two Russian fundraising projects supporting Ukrainians and political prisoners, exposing donor email addresses and limited payment card information.

top_signals.title: Burnham refuses to rule out more borrowing and blames Tories for debt crisis
